//: nodemon's default here was every file in backend/, which includes
prisma/dev.db — so the server restarted on its OWN database writes. A
normal request never writes enough to notice, but a data import writes
thousands of rows, and each restart killed the request that was doing the
writing. Two batch-2 imports died this way at the same point, which looked
like a timeout and was actually the dev server rebooting under itself.
src is where the code lives, so it is the only thing worth watching.
scripts/ is excluded on purpose too: those are run by hand and editing one
should not bounce a running server.
